The '''Ryborean sector''' was located in the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Location" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Drannik sector/Legends|Drannik sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction and the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]]. At its [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] edge the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] formed a four-way border with the [[Deadalis sector/Legends|Deadalis sector]] as well as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Abaar sector/Legends|Abaar]] and [[Vorc sector/Legends|Vorc sectors]].<ref name="Expansion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref> The sector retained those borders by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], by which [[Time/Legends|time]] it was situated within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

The Ryborean sector contained the [[Ryborea system/Legends|Ryborea system]],<ref name="EGtW" /> the origin point of the [[Ryborean gax]] beverage,<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Ryborean gax]]|system=[[Ryborea system/Legends|Ryborea system]]|legends=1}}</ref> and the [[Aramal system/Legends|Aramal system]], which was situated at the intersection of two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. One of the routes linked the Ryborean to the Deadalis and Drannik sectors, while the other joined it with the Vorc sector and the Inner Rim.<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ryborean sector was established in<ref name="EGtW" /> the [[April 3]], [[2012]]<ref name="Penguin-Paperback">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/180097/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-star-wars-by-jason-fry-with-paul-r-urquhart/9780345477620|text=The Essential Guide to Warfare: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" /> On [[October 26]] of the same year, the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," a feature of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to<ref name="Expansion" /> the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> which placed it in grid squares J-7 and J-8.<ref name="Expansion" />
